_comment: Golden vectors for URL canonicalisation. Asserted by BOTH sides:
The CLI and the extension write into the same `id` column, so if these two
implementations ever disagree, one posting becomes two rows and nothing
reports it. Seven of these cases used to diverge.
Add a case here before changing either implementation.

vectors.why: an ordinary URL is unchanged
accented path bytes are preserved, not percent-encoded
an already-encoded path keeps its encoding
an IDN host is not punycoded
the scheme and host lowercase; the path does not
a default port is dropped
a non-default port is kept
the fragment goes
tracking parameters go, others stay in order
a query of nothing but tracking leaves no question mark
a plus in a query value is not re-encoded
dot segments are left alone — resolving them is a normalisation only one side did
a trailing slash is stripped
several trailing slashes are stripped
a relative URL still loses its tracking parameters
surrounding whitespace goes
an empty string stays empty
a Nordic slug keeps its characters
a French accented slug keeps its characters
the host lowercases even with a port and userinfo present
